chunks: Al-Ridha, peace be upon him, wrote to Muhammad ibn Sinan regarding what he wrote in reply to his questions:
"The reason women are given half of what men are given from inheritance is that when a woman marries, she receives, while the man gives; therefore, more has been allotted to men."

And another reason for giving the male twice what is given to the female is that the female is among the dependents of the male if she is in need, and it is upon him to maintain her and upon him is her financial support. It is not upon the woman to maintain the man, nor is she charged with his expenses if he is in need. So more has been allotted to the man for that reason, and that is the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
۝ Men are maintainers of women because Allah has given some of them an advantage over others and because they spend from their wealth. ۝

key_terms.عِلَّةُ إِعْطَاءِ: the legal rationale or cause for assigning a ruling
key_terms.فِي عِيَالِ ٱلذَّكَرِ: under the support and care of the male
key_terms.قَوَّامُونَ عَلَى ٱلنِّسَاءِ: maintainers and caretakers of women in financial responsibility
key_terms.مِثْلَيْ مَا تُعْطَى ٱلْأُنْثَىٰ: twice the amount given to the female

ai.seo_question: Why does a man receive a larger inheritance share than a woman in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the legal rationale for the inheritance rule in which a male receives twice the share of a female in certain cases. It grounds that ruling in the man’s financial obligations, including maintenance and spending, and cites Qur'an 4:34 as support for that framework.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.5755 - Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha (as) wrote to Muhammad ibn Sinan in response to his questions:
"The reason women are given half of what men receive from inheritance is because when a woman marries, she receives, whereas a man gives. Therefore, more has been allocated to men."
Imam (as) continued: "Another reason for giving the male twice as much as the female is that the female is under the care of the male if she is in need, and it is his responsibility to support her and provide for her. However, a woman is not required to support a man, nor is she responsible for his expenses if he is in need. Therefore, more has been allocated to the man for this reason. This is in accordance with the saying of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic:
'Men are the protectors and maintainers of women because Allah (swt) has given one more (strength) than the other and because they spend from their wealth.'" (Surah An-Nisa 4:34).
